description: This file defines the DotReporter class, a custom test reporter for Playwright that outputs test progress and results in a dot-based format, extending the TerminalReporter class.

classes.name: DotReporter
classes.description: A test reporter class for Playwright that outputs test progress in a dot format, handling stdout, stderr, test end, errors, pauses, and end of test suite.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, outputs starting message.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles standard output during tests, writes output if not in quiet mode.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles standard error during tests, writes error output if not in quiet mode.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test, outputs a symbol based on test outcome.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during testing, outputs error message.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles paused test state, outputs pause information and waits.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of the test suite, outputs final epilogue.
